Subject: Orbit Health — Pricing & Invoice Estimate (post-call recap)

Hi Samir / Lina — great to meet you both on the call this morning. Recap below and next steps so we can get an invoice estimate over to procurement.

Key items from the call:
- Expected steady-state usage: ~150M tokens / month (text generation + some reranking).
- Peak/spike scenarios: up to ~300M tokens / month for campaigns.
- Primary requirement: predictable unit economics to present to Finance (target $/1M tokens to be negotiated).
- Security/regulatory: standard SOC2 + VPC option may be requested later (flagged to the Infra team).

Questions we agreed to clarify in follow-up:
1) Confirm expected committed monthly tokens (baseline vs peak).
2) Target budget range / target $ per 1M tokens for committed pricing.
3) Billing cadence & PO timing (monthly vs quarterly invoicing).
4) Line-item breakdown for an invoice (committed tier, overage rate, embeddings vs generation if applicable).

Attached: orbit_pricing_calculator_v3.xlsx (working cost model) and orbit_cost_breakdown.pdf (line-item explainer). I've put a Drive link in case you want to comment directly: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake/abc123-pricing

Next steps: If you can confirm the committed tokens and preferred billing cadence, I will send a formal invoice estimate and committed pricing tiers that you can share with procurement.

Thanks,

Thanks Sean — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Baseline: we expect ~150M tokens/month initially (customer support + triage workflows).
- Spikes: during marketing/event-driven spikes we could hit ~250-300M tokens for short windows.
- Budget: Finance gave us a ballpark of $30k–$60k/month for inference costs; our pragmatic target is to keep unit costs around ~$275 / 1M tokens if possible.

What we need from you for procurement: 
- A one-page invoice estimate that shows committed tiers (monthly tokens), effective $/1M at each tier, and an overage rate.
- Billing cadence options (monthly invoicing vs quarterly commitment invoicing) and any minimum term.
- Any discounts for a 12-month commit vs month-to-month.

If you can send an invoice estimate we can route to our procurement team (they prefer a single PDF to attach to the PO). Also confirm whether tax/VAT is shown separately.

Regards,
Samir Bose
Head of Partnerships | Orbit Health

Looping in billing notes for clarity before Sean sends the final PDF to Samir/procurement.

Suggested committed tiers (provisional):
- Tier A: 0–100M tokens/month — $350 / 1M tokens
- Tier B: 100–300M tokens/month — $300 / 1M tokens
- Tier C: 300M+ tokens/month — $250 / 1M tokens
- Overage: billed at 125% of the committed tier rate (applies to usage beyond committed tier in the billing period).

Other items to include on the invoice estimate:
- Billing cadence: monthly invoicing by default; can offer quarterly invoices for 12-month commitments.
- Minimum term: 1 month for month-to-month; 12 months for committed discounted pricing.
- Taxes/VAT: shown as separate line item; customer responsible unless otherwise agreed.
- PO requirements: we accept standard PO + signed SOW for Dedicated/Private (if requested).

I generated a quick invoice_estimate PDF and added line item detail to orbit_pricing_calculator_v3.xlsx (see attachments). I recommend presenting the Tier B pricing as the near-term recommended position given Orbit's ~150M baseline (gives them reasonable blended unit economics).

Marissa Cole
